test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: What is the edge of a cube whose volume is equal to the sum of the volumes of the cubes of edge 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm?
solution:
Given: Three metal cubes whose edges are 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm.

Concept Used: Total volume will be constant.

Volume of cube = (Edge)3 

Calculation: 

V1 = (6)3 = 216 cm3

V2 = (8)3 = 512 cm3

V3 = (10)3 = 1000 cm3

Now, new cube volume V = V1 + V2 + V3 

(Edge)3 = 216 + 512 + 1000

(Edge)3 = 1728

Edge = 12 cm

So, Edge of new cube is 12 cm.
